source.nextStart: After being robbed to the tune of 3,000,000,000 won
source.nextEndBefore: Lee Hyun’s cold eyes stared at the monitor.

completed.end: Hyun lists Weed at 50,000 won for one day, then sleeps.
CTS Media buys Weed for 3,090,000,000 won. Hyun verifies the money and shares the bankbook and hope with Grandmother. Stop before moving and hospital treatment.
Debt collectors take three billion won, return 90 million and the IOU, and leave after Han Jinsup’s five-year challenge. Stop before the three days of despair.

defaults.scope: One small dramatic development; source fidelity determines the boundary.
defaults.choices: Usually 2–3 brief reconnecting choices, with a distinct response and callbacks where useful.
defaults.length: Usually 40–60 voiced entries; flexible, not a quota.
defaults.assets: Reuse the version 2 LMS cast from stories/characters/lms-cast.json, built by npm run game:cast. Weed uses a lean face, keen eyes, tousled black hair and a slate work shirt. All facial expressions remain articulated SVG. New characters use polished SVG.
defaults.language: Simplified Mandarin, natural phrases, contextual glosses and reviewed pinyin.
defaults.voice: Tingting, 165 wpm, AAC 32 kbps; exact-text cache.
defaults.memory: Within-episode variables only; no invented cross-episode memory.

continuity: Grandmother remains hospitalized. Hyun has 90 million won left before the new-home contract expense; the old debt is paid.
Han Jinsup challenged Hyun to make three billion won within five years. No blow landed in the hospital.
Episode 3 stops at the immediate aftermath. Read the next pinned passage before defining episode 4.
Reuse Hyun and the new hospital/collector cast from episode 3; the home background remains available in episode 2. Phone staging uses moonlight-02-v2 without changing its source events.
